## The honest truth

**What the IVX IA chat actually does when you type a prompt:**

I just ran your exact screenshot prompt live: `"audit this chat why is a lot loading fix end to end and update deploy live show proof evidence verified"`.

The response came back **FAILED**:


| Capability | Real status |
|---|---|
| Answer simple questions ("what is 2+2") | ✅ Works |
| Read-only inspection (inspect files, don't change) | ✅ Works — returns real file list |

| **Autonomously fix a bug you describe in chat** | ❌ **HAS NEVER WORKED END-TO-END** |
| **Autonomously commit a real code fix from your chat prompt** | ❌ **HAS NEVER CONVERGED LIVE** |
| Create app from scratch (new repo, provision, scaffold) | ❌ Architecturally blocked |

Here is the brutal honest answer:

**Every "VERIFIED" task in the entire plan history was executed by ME — the Rork agent — using the owner-gated APIs. NOT by the IVX IA chat autonomously responding to your prompts in the chat UI.**
